notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.

The article s001 governs οἴκου across the interposed adjective under rule 57, but rule 47 empties it because ἴδιος stands attributively before an expressed head noun and carries the supplied *his own*.

προϊστάμενον has no Greek article before it, so the supplied antecedent and relativizer *one that* are rule 7/86 helpers on the participle itself; contrast 1TI.3.13, where οἱ is present and takes *they* under rule 32.
τέκνα is anarthrous, so its supplied possessive is an ordinary rule 7/51 helper on the noun, and rule 11 keeps the ASV's italics from making it `added`.
